req.title: Reject empty firstName
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the Player payload contains an empty firstName.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-022 requires HTTP 422 when firstName is empty string. We need: (1) a positive case proving a valid payload with non-empty firstName returns 201, (2) a negative case proving empty string firstName returns 422, (3) a boundary case proving a single-character firstName (length=1, the minimum non-empty value) returns 201 while empty string (length=0) returns 422. Additional cases cover whitespace-only firstName and missing firstName key to maximise mutation kill rate by asserting exact status codes 422 vs 201.

Response body contains a valid UUID id field

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Carlos",
        "lastName": "Tevez",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Centre-Forward"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Carlos"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Tevez"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None

test_post_player_valid_firstname_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_empty_firstname_vs_valid_firstname_contrast
preconditions: Squad numbers 93 and 94 do not exist in the database
actions: Assert the two responses differ at the boundary
expected: Boundary between invalid and valid is at length=1
trace: R-PLAYER-022: BVA at length 0 vs 1 — catches off-by-one mutations on min-length validation
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_empty_firstname_vs_valid_firstname_contrast():
    base = {"lastName": "Ortega", "position": "Attacking Midfield"}
    r_empty = client.post("/players/", json={**base, "firstName": "", "squadNumber": 93})
    assert r_empty.status_code == 422
    r_single = client.post("/players/", json={**base, "firstName": "X", "squadNumber": 94})
    assert r_single.status_code == 201
    assert r_single.json()["firstName"] == "X"
    assert r_single.json()["squadNumber"] == 94

test_post_player_empty_firstname_vs_valid_firstname_contrast()
